fixes.description: Fixed the sidebar hiding when the mouse is still over it.
Fixed devtools not appearing on glance tabs.
Boosts zap bar will now push the web contents up when activated.

features: Boosts now have a 'focus' feature, allowing you to concentrate on a specific part of the website.
Windows builds now run with CSIR PGO, improving performance and startup times. All other platforms also have performance improvements.
